def parse_records(text):
    lines=text.splitlines()
    out=[]
    for l in lines:
        stripped=l.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('#'):  # whole-line comment only
            continue
        if not stripped:  # blank lines stay excluded (intended)
            continue
        out.append(l)  # preserve surrounding whitespace verbatim
    return out
